subject: Hosted API evaluation — next steps & quickstart
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeretail.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Feb 2026 17:20:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API evaluation — next steps & quickstart

Hi Alex —

Great to meet you and Priya on the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the Hosted API evaluation we discussed:

Recap:
- You want to validate LLM-powered product-search ranking and a conversational FAQ assistant.
- Initial success criteria: parity with your current model on relevance, <200ms p50 latency for single-shot queries, and ability to sustain ~300 req/min peak.
- Primary question is deployment mode: start on Hosted API for fast iteration, then evaluate Dedicated if sustained throughput/latency reliability is needed, and Private VPC for any PHI/regulatory constraints.

Hosted API quickstart and what I changed for the eval:
- Endpoint: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
- Example curl (replace REDWOOD_API_KEY):
  curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \n    -H "Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD_API_KEY" \n    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n    -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","prompt":"<your-prompt>","max_tokens":256}'

- Default Hosted limits: 60 requests/min and 100k tokens/min for new orgs; for this eval I can request a temporary raise to ~300 req/min and 300k tokens/min to match your peak. We can also provision a dedicated dev pool if you want to stress test sustained traffic.
- Quickstart doc attached (hosted_api_quickstart.pdf) and link: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/hosted-api

Security & compliance:
- Hosted does persist logs for 30 days by default; we offer no-retention eval toggles and can export audit logs for SOC/audit review. I attached our SOC2 Type II report and an SLA summary.

Next steps (proposed):
1) You share a small test corpus and 2-3 representative prompts.
2) We enable temporary higher rate limits and provide you with an API key + sample endpoints.
3) Aditya (SE) and I run a 1-hour load test next week to validate latency under your peak.
4) Schedule a short security call if you need deeper compliance answers (Priya, happy to loop our security lead).

If that plan sounds good I will: (a) enable the rate increase, (b) upload SOC2/SLA to the HubSpot record, and (c) circulate a calendar invite for the load test.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
---
Attachments: hosted_api_quickstart.pdf, SLA-overview.pdf

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeretail.com>

Date: Fri, 06 Feb 2026 10:14:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — next steps & quickstart

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary. A few follow-ups from our side:

1) Data residency & retention: our legal team is asking whether Hosted stores raw request/response payloads outside the region. We process some PII and would need either guaranteed EU/US residency or a clear deletion policy.
2) Throughput: 300 req/min is our peak, but sustained during campaigns could last several hours. For the eval, a temporary raise is fine but if we move to production we may need Dedicated.
3) Audit logs: can we get an export of request logs for a 90-day window for compliance?
4) Trial & costs: what trial credits are available for a full eval? Also, will the eval be limited to a single endpoint or can we run two endpoints (search + chat) simultaneously?

Priya and I are available next Wed/Thu mornings EST for the load test.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Senior Product Manager, Acme Retail
alex.johnson@acmeretail.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeretail.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 06 Feb 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — next steps & quickstart

Alex — thanks for the questions, short answers below:

1) Residency & retention: Hosted tenancy is regional by cloud region; for US customers requests are processed in US regions by default. We persist request/response logs 30 days but can enable a 0-day retention (no retention) mode for evals and support exports of logs. For EU residency we can route requests to EU regions.

2) Throughput & Dedicated: For sustained high-throughput (multi-hour campaigns at 300+ req/min) we typically recommend Dedicated capacity. For the evaluation phase we will raise Hosted limits to 300 req/min and 300k tokens/min and can run two endpoints in parallel (search + chat). If you want to validate sustained performance we'll provision a dev-dedicated pool for a limited window.

3) Audit logs: yes — we can provide redacted request logs and a 90-day export for compliance review; I'll attach SOC2 and the SLA overview (attached).

4) Trial credits: I can add $5,000 in evaluation credits to your account to cover the initial testing.

Next step: Aditya — can you coordinate the load test with Alex/Priya and provision the temporary rate increase / dev pool? Alex/Priya — what time Wed/Thu morning EST works for you?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2-Type2-2025.pdf, SLA-overview.pdf

Hi Alex / Priya — looping in as SE to run the perf test. Proposed plan:

- Provision a temporary dev-dedicated pool for a 2-hour window (same model as production) and enable Hosted rate bump to 300 req/min and 300k tokens/min.
- Run a stepped load test: 50 -> 150 -> 300 req/min over 20-minute intervals, track p50/p95 latency and error rates, and export logs.
- Validate two endpoints concurrently (search + chat).

Available slots (EST): Wed 10:00-12:00, Thu 09:00-11:00. Please confirm a slot and share a test dataset (5-10 representative queries + sample payloads).
